metadata.source: Georgia General Assembly Office of Legislative & Congressional Reapportionment block-equivalency files, joined to U.S. Census Bureau 2020 block populations
metadata.note: For each county, the 2020 population living in each district of each plan, and that as a share of the county. Districts are listed in number order. A county in several districts appears once per district. Matches the Office of Legislative and Congressional Reapportionment's county reports.
